licoes.objectivo: Rever as unidades 6 a 8 do B1.

exercicios.frase: When I arrived, the meeting [had] already started.
[Because] the drain was blocked, the water stayed on the roof.
That [can't] be right. We didn't buy anything.

opcoes.texto: It cost sixty-five million of kwanzas.
She told me to call Kagiso the next day.
She told me call Kagiso the next day.
She said me to call Kagiso the next day.

exercicios.enunciado: Which question is the most polite?

opcoes.texto: Will you be using the car tomorrow?

exercicios.frase: I'm Nuno. While the night guard was doing his round, there was a short circuit. By the time I arrived, he'd already put out the fire.
exercicios.enunciado: What had the guard done by the time Nuno arrived?

opcoes.texto: He had put out the fire.

exercicios.enunciado: Ele perguntou-me se eu queria liderar a equipa.
exercicios.resposta: He asked me if I wanted to lead the team.

exercicios.frase: By the time I arrived, he'd already put out the fire.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, em dois grupos.
Tell me about a problem or an incident at work or at home: what happened, why, and what you did.
exercicios.resposta: Last year our office lost its internet for a day. At first, we didn't know why. Then the technician found that a construction company had cut a cable in the street. As a result, we worked from a café. In the end, the connection came back at six.

exercicios.enunciado: Report a call or a meeting you had recently: what did the other person say, ask and promise?
exercicios.resposta: Yesterday my manager called me. She said the board wanted the report two days earlier, and she asked me if I could finish it by Tuesday. I told her it would be difficult. She promised to give me help from another team.

licoes.titulo: Review 2: opinions, lessons and the exam
licoes.objectivo: Rever as unidades 9 e 10 do B1 e preparar o exame oral.

exercicios.frase: If we had known, we [would have] waited.
It [can't have] been the weather. The satellite worked in bigger storms.

opcoes.texto: According to the article, prices went up.
According the article, prices went up.
According to me, prices went up.

exercicios.enunciado: In part 2 of the B1.2 exam, you…

opcoes.texto: tell a story about a problem you lived

exercicios.enunciado: In the discussion, you need a few seconds to think. You say:

exercicios.frase: I'm Lurdes. If we had had a second connection, we wouldn't have closed for a day.

opcoes.texto: A second connection would have kept the branch open.
The branch should close every day.

exercicios.enunciado: Por um lado, é mais rápido; por outro lado, é mais caro.
exercicios.resposta: On the one hand, it's faster. On the other hand, it's more expensive.

exercicios.frase: That's an interesting question. It depends on the situation.

exercicios.enunciado: Is it better to work for a big company or a small one? Show both sides and give your view.
exercicios.resposta: That's an interesting question. On the one hand, a big company gives you training and a stable salary. On the other hand, in a small company you learn faster. So, overall, I think a big company is better at the start of your career.

exercicios.enunciado: Tell me about a decision you made this year. What should you have done differently, and what are you hoping to do next?
exercicios.resposta: This year I changed teams at work. I should have asked more questions before I accepted, because the hours are longer. But I'm learning a lot. Next year, I'm hoping to lead a small project.
